derived_outputs_status: candidate_until_reviewed; explicit user rejection remains effective regardless of technical pass
identity_features: fine fluffy cream-white fur with warm ivory shadows, directional cheek/chest strands and soft silhouette wisps
broad rounded face, full cheeks and compact soft chin; preserve facial layout and proportions as the requested action changes head orientation, avoiding a narrow egg-shaped head
large gray-brown eyes seated in shaped upper/lower eyelids with softly almond-rounded openings, readable iris and pupil; no protruding circular bead eyes
broad-rooted outward ears with blush inner recesses, curved rims and fine edge fur; no tall upright triangle plates
tiny dusty-pink nose, paired soft muzzle pads, short philtrum and rounded chin; no flat face with a line smile
compact softly full feline body, coherent shoulder/chest/haunch structure and short limbs; the selected master is seated but requested actions may change stance
rounded paws with curved toes enclosing pink pads, bent raised wrist and readable grounded toe divisions; no flat palm with coin-like pads
full fluffy low-rooted curled tail with thickness taper and a softly narrowing tip; no thin smooth ring-shaped tube
small sakura silk scarf and tiny warm-gold four-point star clasp; identity must remain recognizable beyond these accessories
welcoming curious expression; retain the reference raised-paw sitting pose for reconstruction comparisons before requested pose variations
authority_note: Reference selection and file integrity do not grant external provider spend, change pet progression or approve derived assets.
identity_authority: The original selected image is the sole identity authority for the current main cat; later inferred views and rejected models cannot supersede it.

checkpoints: selected original and actual 2D output identity
real planar or frame motion and pause/fallback, then delivery optimization
likeness_workflow.new_angle_images: optional inferred design reference only; no current 3D creation requirement
likeness_workflow.evidence: actual comparisons and specific visual observations; no invented similarity score
likeness_workflow.permission: Use existing valid task authorization; checkpoints do not require new permission for every ordinary low-risk creative step.

rejected_outputs.reason: User found the 3D character ugly and unlike the selected original image; face, eyes, muzzle, ears, paws, body, fur and tail require reconstruction.
rejected_outputs.derived_outputs: The exclusion includes posters and animations rendered from this model; keep only labeled historical failure evidence when required.
rejected_outputs.reinstatement: A technical pass, rename or repackaging cannot override the user rejection.

visual_policy.authority: latest explicit user instruction: real 2D pet actions, locomotion/jumping/emotions/daily behaviors; reliable 3D only in a future upgrade
priority: original character identity and image quality
visual_policy.fallback: selected original static image; never fall back to rejected 3D or inferior redraw
future_3d_requirements: actually available and permitted capable tool or modeling workflow
actual mesh likeness checked against the selected original
authorized data/provider/cost and target runtime evidence
visual_policy.renderer_compatibility: Keep stable character_id and appearance lineage; representation and renderer are replaceable fields, not new progression or identity.
visual_policy.required_current_motion: Real articulated character actions; static fallback and motion-posters do not satisfy requested animation.
